what_it_does: LABMATE is a multi-agent system where multiple specialized language model agents work together to accelerate catalysis experiments. Each agent handles a specific task: one submits simulations, another tracks particles, a third analyzes data, and others review literature or generate new hypotheses. Human experts remain in control to validate the results at each step. The system integrates simulation tools, data analysis capabilities, and literature search into a coordinated workflow that LLMs alone cannot reliably do.
